# Vendored zstd (decoder only)

- Upstream: Zstandard 1.5.7, https://github.com/facebook/zstd/releases/tag/v1.5.7, `zstd-1.5.7.tar.gz`, SHA-256
  `eb33e51f49a15e023950cd7825ca74a4a2b43db8354825ac24fc1b7ee09e6fa3` (matches the release's `.sha256`), retrieved
  2026-10-03.
- Licence: dual BSD-3-Clause or GPLv2; FultaArc uses it under the BSD licence (`LICENSE`, the release's `LICENSE`).
  Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates.
- Files: `zstddeclib.c`, generated by the release's own `build/single_file_libs/create_single_file_decoder.sh`
  (decoder only; legacy formats off, `ZSTD_LEGACY_SUPPORT 0`; assembly off, `ZSTD_DISABLE_ASM 1`), not edited;
  `zstd.h` and `zstd_errors.h` from `lib/`, unchanged, for the API.
- Used for ZIP method 93 and the 7z coder `04F71101` (`src/codec/codecs.c`, `fa_dec_zstd`); the window is limited by
  FultaArc's dictionary limit (`ZSTD_d_windowLogMax`).
